## Key facts
- Role: UGC creator, Instagram Reels creator, content creator for apps and AI tools
- Best fit for: mobile apps, AI tools, SaaS, EdTech, creator and video-editing apps, lifestyle brands
- Languages: English, Russian
- Accounts: @bazaluk.creates (English, https://www.instagram.com/bazaluk.creates/), @kseniabazaluk (Russian, https://www.instagram.com/kseniabazaluk/)
- Organic reach: 1,288,795 views on @bazaluk.creates between 20 Aug and 20 Oct 2026, with /bin/zsh paid promotion

- English account audience: 64.5% women; 48% aged 25–34
- Creator tips content: home lighting for filming (13,801 views, 357 saves), how to film with an iPhone and wireless mic (7,147 views), Apple marketing trend breakdown (4,330 views)
- Services: Instagram Reels integrations, UGC app demo videos, AI tool tutorials and trend content, Russian-language market content, creator tips and filming gear content, testing with trial Reels
- Process: concept & script → film & edit (multiple hooks) → test with trial Reels → publish with optional brand co-authorship
